note:
From the Massachusetts lab.

- **LiDAR local relief:** MassGIS's statewide 1 m LiDAR shaded relief shows stone walls, cellar holes and old roads under the forest, which no other layer shows. Public 1 m DEMs cover only some places (US 3DEP, parts of Europe, Japan and others) and are large (Massachusetts alone ~5 GB), so this is per area, not worldwide.
- **Old maps:** the USGS Historical Topographic Map collection (US, 1880s on) as a basemap switch; other countries have their own national archives.

Neither has a worldwide source. That's why the generalized lab (#100) left them out.
text: From the lab: LiDAR local relief where public 1 m DEMs exist (stone walls, old roads under the forest), built per area on demand; and old topos as a basemap time switch (1885 / 1950 / now)
